title: A run for the whole family
body: Two out-and-back races on the Adirondack Rail Trail: a 10K and a 5K, both starting and finishing at Bike Lake Placid. Kids of all ages are welcome, and dogs can run the 5K. Afterwards there is food, drink, music and awards, and flowers for the top three mothers in each division. Your registration helps support the Adirondack Rail Trail Association and, from the 5K, the Tri-Lakes Humane Society.
